description: Switch thrown under a train running facing through it (#289 review 2b): as eu07_td_switch_thrown_facing_head, but zwr01 is thrown to track 1 when the locomotive has left the switch for track 2 (event of tor2p, set off by its rear axle), with the coaches still before and on the switch. A train cannot run on two tracks at once: every vehicle has to keep to the line of a track, whatever the throw does to them.

trainsets: node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_c1 dynamic pkp\bdhpumn_v3 bdhpumn_50512608068-6 BDHPUMN_TAPICERKA_1 0 nobody 3 0 enddynamic
node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_c2 dynamic pkp\bdhpumn_v3 bdhpumn_50512608068-6 BDHPUMN_TAPICERKA_1 0 nobody 3 0 enddynamic
node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_c3 dynamic pkp\bdhpumn_v3 bdhpumn_50512608068-6 BDHPUMN_TAPICERKA_1 0 nobody 0 0 enddynamic
vars.route: node -1 0 autotest_route_launcher eventlauncher 0 0 0 -1 none 1034 keyctrl01 end

xfail: #289 review 2b, as before the stack (TrkFoll reverted in c268673c): the axles still on the switch leave it by the way it is set to now, those behind it take that way too, so the coaches go to track 1 and the locomotive they are coupled to runs on along track 2, 4.6 m beside them, with nothing derailed or broken
